Gaurav Saxena 92  
Tel Aviv, Israel | +972 52 345 6789 | gaurav.saxena@cloudnexus.com | linkedin.com/in/gauravsaxena | github.com/gauravsaxena  

Professional Experience  
As a Senior DevOps Consultant at CloudNexus Solutions, I have dedicated the past three years to designing and maintaining scalable infrastructure for enterprise clients across Israel and the Middle East. My work focuses on aligning technical solutions with business objectives, ensuring reliability, cost efficiency, and seamless integration across hybrid and multi-cloud environments. Previously, at InnovateX Technologies, I led the transition from monolithic to microservices architecture, which reduced deployment latency by 40% and improved system resilience through proactive incident management. This role also involved optimizing cloud cost structures, achieving a 25% reduction in operational expenses by leveraging Terraform for infrastructure as code and refining auto-scaling policies. Earlier, at TechNova Startups, I automated deployment pipelines using GitHub Actions, which streamlined release cycles and minimized manual intervention, allowing teams to focus on feature development.  

Technical Skills  
My expertise lies in orchestrating complex systems that balance agility with stability. I have architected CI/CD platforms using ArgoCD, enabling teams to deploy applications across Kubernetes clusters with zero-downtime updates. This work involved integrating Prometheus and Grafana for real-time monitoring, which allowed us to correlate system metrics with business KPIs and proactively address performance bottlenecks. I also specialize in Kubernetes, where I have designed scalable cluster architectures, implemented rolling updates, and mentored engineers on best practices for pod management and service discovery. Load balancing strategies, such as using NGINX and HAProxy, have been critical in ensuring high availability for mission-critical applications. My work with Linux administration has included automating routine tasks via Python scripts, which improved system maintenance efficiency by 30%. PostgreSQL is occasionally referenced in the context of database integration, but my primary focus remains on infrastructure and automation.  

Projects  
A notable project involved migrating a legacy application to a multi-cloud environment, where I designed a hybrid infrastructure using Terraform and AWS/GCP services. This effort reduced dependency on a single provider and improved disaster recovery capabilities. Another initiative centered on implementing SLA/SLO management frameworks, which involved defining service-level targets, tracking compliance, and aligning incident response protocols with business impact analysis. These frameworks were instrumental in reducing unplanned downtime by 35% across client systems. Additionally, I spearheaded a chaos engineering program that simulated real-world failures, identifying vulnerabilities in the architecture and strengthening the team’s resilience to outages.  

Education  
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Indian Institute of Technology, Kanpur (2016).  

Languages  
English (native), Hebrew (professional working knowledge).  

Volunteer / Open Source  
Contributed to open-source projects such as Prometheus and Grafana, enhancing documentation and adding support for custom metrics. Also, volunteered as a mentor for DevOps bootcamps in Tel Aviv, focusing on practical implementations of CI/CD and infrastructure automation.
